title: Supply of Laboratory Reagents and Consumables
content: Sealed tenders are invited from registered firms for the supply of laboratory reagents and consumables to Gomal Medical College for the year 2026-27.
tender_eligibility: GST/NTN registered firms with at least 3 years of relevant experience.

title: Annual Maintenance of HVAC and Electrical Systems
content: Bids are invited for the annual maintenance contract of HVAC and electrical systems at the college and attached hostels.
tender_eligibility: Registered contractors with PEC license (relevant category).

title: Construction of New Lecture Hall Block
content: Tenders are invited from PEC registered construction firms for the construction of a new lecture hall block within the college premises.
tender_eligibility: PEC registration category C-4 or above; evidence of similar completed projects.

title: Supply and Installation of Library Furniture
content: Sealed bids are invited for the supply and installation of furniture for the central library.

title: Hiring of Security Services
content: Proposals are invited from licensed security agencies for the provision of security guards for the college and hostels.
tender_eligibility: PSARA/licensed security agencies with valid registration.
